verification.label: Verification
verification.description: Anti-bot gate: a button or image captcha grants the verified role that unlocks the server.

feedback.disabled: ❌ Verification is disabled on this server.
feedback.notConfigured: ❌ Verification isn't ready yet (no verified role set). Please tell an administrator.
feedback.cannotAssign: ❌ I can't grant you the verified role. An administrator must check my permissions (Manage Roles + hierarchy).
feedback.captchaInstructions: 🔐 Copy the code shown on the image, then click “Enter code”. Case does not matter.
feedback.captchaWrong: ❌ Wrong code. Try again by clicking “Enter code”.
feedback.captchaExpired: ⌛ The captcha expired. Click “Verify” again to get a new one.
feedback.success: ✅ Verified, welcome! You now have access to the server.
